recognize_zh: 中倍脾臟切片中紅髓內散布大量成群的淡染、透亮泡沫狀組織球，夾在充血的紅髓與小血管之間，是 Niemann-Pick 病脾臟泡沫細胞浸潤的表現。
features: Numerous clusters of large pale histiocytes with clear, foamy cytoplasm throughout the red pulp
Storage cells with small round nuclei, arranged in cords and nests
Intervening congested red pulp with red cells and scattered lymphocytes
No white pulp in this field; no atypical infiltrate
describe_en: Section of spleen at intermediate power shows numerous clusters and cords of large histiocytes with pale, clear, foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei distributed throughout congested red pulp. Scattered small lymphocytes and small vessels are present, and no atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by lipid-laden foam cells, compatible with Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear vacuolated cytoplasm.
HCL red pulp infiltrates consist of monotonous small B cells with blood lakes rather than large foamy histiocytes.
Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms demonstrable by AFB or PAS stains and often accompany granulomas.
